key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A572
name: exit_immediately_stub
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work and returns to its caller at once. The code shows no data access or calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A662
name: clear_buffer_from_pointer
description: Stores an address register value into a pointer slot of the global data block, then zeroes 115 consecutive bytes starting at that address.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A674
name: clear_flagged_table_entries
description: Zeroes a 16-bit counter, then walks a 115-entry table from index 114 down to 0 and clears each entry whose bit 5 is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A696
name: clear_entry_and_decrement
description: Reads a table index from a field of the record in an address register. If that table entry has bit 5 set it decrements a 16-bit counter, and it then clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A6BA
name: call_nested_routine_wrapper
description: Calls one nested routine and returns straight away with no other logic. The callee is not named in the evidence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A6C4
name: dispatch_slots_or_clear_entry
description: If the table entry's bit 5 is clear, it walks an 8-byte slot list, calls the method at offset 48 of each slot whose bit 2 is set, and clears the entry. If the bit is set, it decrements a 16-bit counter and clears the entry instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A710
name: dispatch_slots_then_update_counter
description: Calls the offset-48 method of every flagged slot in a list, then subtracts an amount from a 16-bit field of the record and carries any underflow into a second field. The pseudo-code is truncated, so the later branches are not described.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A7CE
name: call_handler_return_pair
description: Calls a routine through a pointer in the global table and returns a 64-bit value whose high half is 1 and whose low half is the D1 register value passed in.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A7E6
name: set_status_bit_then_notify
description: Calls a routine through the global table, sets the lowest bit of a status byte in the record, and calls a second table routine when a record byte equals minus one. It returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A800
name: process_object_state_callbacks
description: Runs a fixed sequence on an object record: an optional adjustment and callback when a flag matches, then fixed values written into record fields and helper loops driven by a counter. The decompiled output has many unnamed calls, so only the visible sequence is described.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A99A
name: return_first_stack_argument
description: Returns the 32-bit value found in the first stack argument slot unchanged. No other work is done.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A0
name: init_record_and_accumulate
description: Stores a 16-bit value into a record field, calls a setup routine, writes fixed initial values into record bytes and words, and adds shifted samples from a source routine into three 32-bit accumulators. It returns the value of a final routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AA0A
name: classify_sample_adjust_totals
description: Calls a setup routine, then classifies a 16-bit sample against the decimal thresholds 2184, 7281 and 21845. Each class adds a table value to shared totals or clears a slot, and a callback is invoked when a record flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AA5A
name: move_flag_between_masks
description: Asks an index routine for a bit position. If that bit is set in the record's 32-bit mask at offset 158, it moves the bit into a second mask at offset 162 and clears it in the first.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AAAC
name: accumulate_band_totals_by_sample
description: Classifies a 16-bit sample into three bands at the decimal thresholds 2184 and 7281. The lower two bands add a class table value, or that value minus four, to three shared totals, and the upper band clears a slot selected by a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AAE6
name: clear_class_add_totals
description: Clears the record's class byte and a 32-bit field. When a record flag is set it adds the class table value to three shared totals, invokes the callbacks and returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB1A
name: set_class_add_reduced_totals
description: Sets the record's class byte to 1 when it is nonzero. When a record flag is set it adds the class table value minus four to three shared totals, invokes the callbacks and returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB50
name: find_bucket_decrement_count
description: Walks a table of 16-bit bucket sizes from its last entry backwards, subtracting each from the sample until the result goes negative. It then decrements the count for the bucket reached and increments a total, and it invokes a callback when a record flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB84
name: advance_motion_timers_return_magnitude
description: Moves a 16-bit speed field toward a target by a scaled step, decays several countdown bytes and words, and sums the absolute values of three velocity components into an amount. That amount is subtracted from a 32-bit timer, and the routine returns it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AC6E
name: consume_timer_handle_expiry
description: Subtracts an amount from a 32-bit timer and returns while it is still running. On expiry it either re-arms the timer after decrementing a shared count, or invokes a callback once and sets a status flag, and then it clears three 32-bit state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACA8
name: rearm_or_expire_timer_state
description: If a shared counter is nonzero, decrements it, increments a second shared counter and re-arms the record timer with a fixed increment. Otherwise it sets a status bit, invokes a callback on the first set, and clears three 32-bit state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB8
name: rearm_countdown_or_clear_state
description: If a countdown byte in the record is nonzero, it decrements the byte and re-arms the record timer with a fixed increment. Otherwise it clears three 32-bit state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACD0
name: set_status_flag_clear_state
description: Sets the lowest bit of a shared status byte and invokes a callback only if that bit was previously clear. It then zeroes three 32-bit state words of the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD02
name: advance_period_timer_and_tally
description: Subtracts an amount from a 32-bit period timer and returns while it is still running. On expiry it re-arms the timer with a fixed reload, decrements two shared counters, and queries a routine; when the checks pass and the record's class byte is nonzero, it clears the class, zeroes the record timer, adds the class table value to three shared totals and invokes a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0A
name: rearm_period_timer_and_tally
description: Re-arms a 32-bit period timer with a fixed reload, decrements two shared counters and queries a routine. When the checks pass and the record's class byte is nonzero, it clears the class, zeroes the record timer, adds the class table value to three shared totals and invokes a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD42
name: tally_class_and_notify
description: If the record's class byte is nonzero, clears it and the record timer, adds the class table value to three shared totals, and invokes a callback. It does nothing otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD76
name: tally_class_when_count_exceeds
description: Calls a routine and compares the low byte of its result with a shared counter. When the value exceeds the counter and the record's class byte is nonzero, it clears the class and timer, adds the class table value to three shared totals and invokes a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD7C
name: tally_class_on_zero_status
description: Calls a routine and, only when its result sets the zero status, compares the low byte with a shared counter and tallies the record's class when the value is larger. A callback is then invoked on the paths that reach the end.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_index_and_dispatch
description: Stores a 16-bit value into record field 6. If the previous value was nonzero, it uses that old value as an index into a pointer table and calls the method at offset 36 of the object found there.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_value_field_six
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value into the record field at offset 6 and returns. Nothing else happens.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_table_by_input_range
description: Returns a 16-bit entry from the global lookup table for a 32-bit input. The table index and right shift are chosen by the input range, with a separate fallback read for large values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_slot_table_and_methods
description: Clears record field 6, stores two fixed 32-bit constants in the record and fills a series of pointer slots with routine addresses and the global data address. It then walks the 8-byte slot list up to the limit at offset 10, copying each slot's pointer into the record and calling the routine at offset 4 of the structure it points to.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: initialize_record_then_run_slots
description: Sets two fixed constants when the input is below 1024, then resets several timers and counters in the record. It runs the slot list once for each step from the input value up to five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: process_periodic_slot_callbacks
description: Clears status bits 2 to 4 and calls the offset-16 method of each active slot. It then divides an elapsed counter by 49710, calls the offset-44 method of every flagged slot with the whole number of periods, and invokes the offset-28 method of the slot selected by each flagged table entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: invoke_active_slot_handlers
description: Walks the 8-byte slot list and calls the offset-20 method of each slot whose flag byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: dispatch_slot_by_key_byte
description: If status bit 0 is clear, it gets a key byte from a routine and searches the slot list for an entry with a matching key byte. On a match it calls a routine with the key and then the offset-8 method of that slot; with no match it calls a fallback routine from the global table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_slots_matching_mapped_bit
description: Maps the input code to a bit number: codes 15, 16, 23 and 18 give bits 3, 4, 5 and 6, and any other code gives bit 1. It then calls the offset-12 method of every slot whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: advance_two_word_state
description: Advances two 32-bit state words in place using a shift and rotate, an exclusive-or with a fixed constant and an addition. It returns nothing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: advance_state_return_product
description: Advances the same two state words, then returns the input's low 16 bits multiplied by the high half of the new state, with the halves of the product swapped.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_derived_value
description: Multiplies the low 16 bits of the input by the high half of a value built from a rotate, an addition and a second register, and returns the product with its halves swapped.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_returned_pair
description: Calls a routine that returns a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement negation, carrying from the low word into the high word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: subtract_then_multiply_or_negate
description: Subtracts a 64-bit operand from a register pair. If the high word of the result is non-negative it multiplies two 32-bit register values, otherwise it calls a routine and returns that routine's two's complement negation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: multiply_32_by_32_scaled
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and carry handling. It returns a 64-bit pair built from the product, with the high word shifted left by three bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: compute_scaled_difference_vector
description: Calls a routine twice to get two samples, one from a masked index, and stores their difference and a zero in record fields. It then writes six 32-bit values built from products with a scale into record fields, shifting them right by a count or left when the count is large.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_vector_and_shifted_copy
description: Stores three 32-bit register values into record fields at offsets 44, 48 and 52, then stores three more values shifted left by one less than a count into offsets 56, 60 and 64.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector_components
description: Scales three 16-bit record values by a factor taken from another record field, shifts the products by a count from a further field, and adds the results with carry into six 32-bit record accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: shift_result_by_bit_length
description: Counts how many right shifts the D3 input needs to reach zero, calls a routine for a 64-bit value, and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: shift_result_to_fit_sixteen
description: Right-shifts the D2 input until it is 32767 or less, counting the shifts. It then calls a routine for a 64-bit value and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_each_half_of_result
description: Calls a routine for a 64-bit value and returns it with each 32-bit half negated separately, without carrying between the halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: scale_with_sign_shift_cases
description: Handles three cases by the sign and value of the D3 input. A negative value negates each half of a routine's result, a zero value multiplies two 32-bit values by a scale from D2 or shifts a routine's result, and any other value counts shifts, calls a routine and shifts that result left.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: scale_with_zero_flag_cases
description: When the zero status is set, it multiplies two 32-bit values by a scale from D2, or shifts a routine's result by a counted amount when the scale is large. Otherwise it counts the bits of D3, calls a routine and shifts that result left by the count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: scale_pair_or_shift_result
description: Shifts the D2 input right by seven bits. When the result is 32767 or less it multiplies two 32-bit values by that scale with carries, otherwise it counts the extra shifts, calls a routine and shifts its 64-bit result left by that count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_pair_by_signed_scale
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values by a signed 16-bit scale using 16-bit partial products and carries. It then packs each product with its bits shifted right by one and returns both as a 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: add_wide_value_to_accumulators
description: Calls a routine for a 64-bit value and adds its halves into record accumulators at offsets 44, 48 and 52 with carry. It then adds two record fields read from offsets 98 and 102, and a register value, into the next three accumulators, carrying between them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns, with no logic of its own.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns, with no logic of its own.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns, with no logic of its own.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_word_at_base_offset
description: Returns the 16-bit value stored at the input offset from a base pointer kept in the global data block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_two_pointer_slots
description: Stores two 32-bit register values into adjacent pointer slots in the global data block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: reset_two_pointer_slots
description: Points two adjacent pointer slots in the global data block at the global data area itself.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: claim_indexed_slot_offset
description: If the byte at the input index in a global table is zero and a running offset counter is below 248, it stores the counter as that byte, writes a pair of 16-bit values at the counter position and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: write_offset_byte_and_advance
description: If a running offset counter is below 248, it stores the counter as a byte at the input index in the record, writes an index pair at the counter position and advances the counter by four. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_advance_cursor
description: Writes a byte into the buffer at the given index, writes an index pair at the position held by a 16-bit cursor, and advances that cursor by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no work, so it is a stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: clip_both_pairs_then_call
description: Checks two value pairs against the decimal limits 319 and 167. It re-reads a value through a routine when a pair fails, and calls a further routine only when both pairs pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: call_single_routine_passthrough
description: Calls one nested routine and returns, with no other logic.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: clip_routine_pair_then_call
description: Gets a value pair from a routine and checks it against the decimal limits 319 and 167. A second pair from the registers is checked the same way, re-reading through a routine when needed, and a further routine is called only when both pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: clip_first_pair_then_call
description: Gets a value pair from a routine and returns if either value exceeds the decimal limits 319 or 167. Otherwise it calls a further routine.
